name: Santa Clara County Housing Authority
description: Section 8 housing vouchers for Santa Clara County residents
fullDescription: The Santa Clara County Housing Authority offers voucher programs and rental properties that help more than 20,000 low-income families and individuals throughout Santa Clara County.
whatTheyOffer:
- Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers
- Project-based vouchers and affordable rental properties
- VASH vouchers for homeless veterans
- Special voucher programs (referrals through the county Coordinated Entry System)
- Family Self-Sufficiency program
- Monthly applicant information sessions
howToGetIt:
1. Sign up for SCCHA's Housing Choice Voucher interest lists in the online Applicant Portal
2. When vouchers become available, applicants are randomly selected from the interest lists
3. Must meet income limits
4. Keep your application updated in the Applicant Portal
5. Signing up does not guarantee a voucher, so also look at other affordable housing options
address: 505 W. Julian Street, San Jose, CA 95110
keywords: SCCHA, Santa Clara Housing Authority, Section 8, housing voucher, San Jose, Silicon Valley, low-income, waitlist
